summary: NVIDIA 在 FY2025 10-K 中称自己是全栈计算基础设施公司,按 Compute & Networking 与 Graphics 两个报告分部披露业务,并说明 Data Center、Gaming、Professional Visualization、Automotive 四个目标市场。业务图保留分部、市场与具名产品/服务组三类不同身份。收入图分为分部口径、终端市场口径和 Data Center 内部的 Compute/Networking 三张,金额均由宿主读取选定单元格。本次仅读取冻结的业务描述、收入确认、币种与两张完整收入表,不代表已读全篇。

businesses.name: NVIDIA Corporation(英伟达)
businesses.description: 全栈计算基础设施公司,把硬件、系统、软件、算法、库和服务整合为统一架构的计算平台,面向数据中心规模的 AI 与加速计算。
customers: 云服务提供商与消费互联网公司
游戏玩家与专业创作者

monetization.description: 收入来自产品销售(含硬件和系统)、许可与开发安排、软件许可和云服务。

businesses.name: Compute & Networking 分部
businesses.description: 报告分部,包含 Data Center 加速计算平台及 AI 解决方案和软件、网络、汽车平台及自动驾驶/电动车方案、Jetson 机器人与嵌入式平台、DGX Cloud 云计算服务。
products_services: Data Center 加速计算平台与 AI 软件
汽车平台与自动驾驶/电动车方案

businesses.name: Graphics 分部
businesses.description: 报告分部,包含游戏和 PC 用 GeForce GPU、GeForce NOW 游戏流媒体及相关基础设施、游戏平台方案、Quadro/NVIDIA RTX 工作站 GPU、vGPU 软件、信息娱乐用汽车平台和 Omniverse Enterprise 软件。

businesses.name: Data Center(数据中心市场)
businesses.description: 目标市场之一。NVIDIA Data Center 平台加速 AI、数据分析、图形和科学计算等高算力负载,部署于云、超大规模、本地和边缘数据中心,由计算与网络产品及软件、服务构成,通常以系统、子系统或模块交付。
products_services: Blackwell 架构数据中心基础设施
customers: 公有云与消费互联网公司
OEM、ODM、系统集成商和分销商(直接客户)

monetization.description: 计算与网络产品通常以系统、子系统或模块交付,并配软件和服务;报告的收入确认政策包含产品销售。

businesses.name: Gaming(游戏市场)
businesses.description: 目标市场之一。游戏平台以 GPU 和软件提升游戏画质与体验,NVIDIA RTX 提供光线追踪与 DLSS,并推出 Blackwell GeForce RTX 50 系列。
products_services: 游戏主机 SoC 与开发服务
customers: 主播、广播者、艺术家和创作者

businesses.name: Professional Visualization(专业可视化市场)
businesses.description: 目标市场之一。NVIDIA 与独立软件开发商合作,针对 NVIDIA GPU 优化,服务设计制造和数字内容创作等专业工作流。
customers: 专业艺术家、建筑师和设计师

businesses.name: Automotive(汽车市场)
businesses.description: 目标市场之一。提供从云端到车端的自动驾驶平台方案,以 DRIVE Hyperion 品牌提供端到端自动驾驶解决方案,并与数百家汽车生态伙伴合作。
products_services: DRIVE AGX 计算硬件与 DRIVE OS
customers: 整车厂、卡车制造商、一级供应商、传感器制造商等汽车生态伙伴

businesses.name: Data Center 计算产品
businesses.description: 包括超级计算平台和服务器,整合节能 GPU、CPU、互连和 AI/HPC 软件栈;数据中心平台由 GPU 起步,后扩展至 DPU(FY2022)和 CPU(FY2024)。
products_services: 超级计算平台与服务器
加速库、API、SDK 与领域应用框架

monetization.description: 产品销售(含硬件和系统);产品可带支持或延保,支持与延保收入按服务期间确认。

businesses.name: 网络产品(InfiniBand 与 Ethernet)
businesses.description: InfiniBand 与 Ethernet 端到端平台,包括网卡、线缆、DPU、交换芯片与系统及完整软件栈,使数据中心规模的计算互连成为可能。
customers: 超算与 AI 数据中心客户

monetization.description: 原文的网络段落未单独说明收费方式;公司层面的产品销售政策为一般性披露。

businesses.name: NVIDIA AI Enterprise
businesses.description: 面向企业的企业级 AI 软件套件,原文称其为企业 AI 应用的“操作系统”,属于数据中心计算产品的一部分。
products_services: 企业级 AI 软件套件

monetization.description: 提供付费许可;软件许可可为永久或订阅,并常搭配支持。

businesses.name: DGX Cloud
businesses.description: 完全托管的 AI 训练即服务平台,含云端基础设施与 AI 软件、可定制预训练模型以及对 NVIDIA 专家的访问。
products_services: 云端 AI 基础设施与软件
可定制预训练 AI 模型

monetization.description: 原文对 DGX Cloud 未单列收费方式;云服务收入确认政策称云服务按订阅或订阅加使用量提供,此处不将其视为对 DGX Cloud 的逐项披露。

businesses.name: Jetson 机器人与嵌入式平台
businesses.description: Compute & Networking 分部下的机器人及其他嵌入式平台。所选片段未对其展开更多说明。

businesses.name: NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion 自动驾驶平台
businesses.description: 车端全栈自动驾驶平台:高性能 DRIVE AGX 计算硬件、DRIVE OS 车载操作系统、参考传感器套件,以及用于自动驾驶、建图、泊车和智能座舱体验的开放模块化软件平台。
customers: 整车厂、卡车制造商、一级供应商、传感器制造商、汽车研究机构、高精地图公司和初创公司

businesses.name: GeForce GPU
businesses.description: 面向游戏和 PC 的 GPU,包括 GeForce RTX、GeForce GTX 以及 FY2025 推出的 Blackwell GeForce RTX 50 系列桌面和笔记本 GPU;另有游戏主机 SoC 与开发服务。
products_services: 游戏主机 SoC 与开发服务

monetization.description: 原文未逐项说明 GeForce 的收费方式;产品销售为公司层面的一般收入确认政策。

businesses.name: GeForce NOW 云游戏
businesses.description: 云游戏/游戏流媒体服务,使性能不足的设备也能玩 PC 游戏;Graphics 分部还包含相关基础设施。
products_services: GeForce NOW 游戏流媒体服务

monetization.description: 所选片段未说明 GeForce NOW 的收费方式。

businesses.name: Quadro/NVIDIA RTX 工作站 GPU
businesses.description: 面向企业工作站图形的 GPU;原文称生成式 AI 扩大了企业本地部署 AI 应用对工作站级 GPU 的需求。
customers: 专业艺术家、建筑师和设计师(通过 NVIDIA 合作伙伴产品)

monetization.description: 所选片段未说明工作站 GPU 的收费方式。

businesses.name: vGPU 虚拟 GPU 软件
businesses.description: 面向云端视觉与虚拟计算的软件,用于图形密集的虚拟桌面和工作站。

businesses.name: NVIDIA Omniverse
businesses.description: 用于构建和运行虚拟世界仿真应用的开发平台和操作系统;Graphics 分部列示 Omniverse Enterprise 软件,用于工业 AI 和数字孪生。工业企业用其构建工厂数字孪生、实时 3D 产品配置器并测试验证自主机器人和车辆。

monetization.description: 企业用途为软件订阅,个人使用免费。

businesses.name: 汽车信息娱乐平台
businesses.description: Graphics 分部中用于信息娱乐系统的汽车平台。所选片段对该项的产品细节说明有限。
products_services: 汽车信息娱乐系统平台

evidence.support: Innovation is at our core. We have invested over $58.2 billion in research and development since our inception, yielding inventions that are essential to modern computing. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market and redefined computer graphics. With our introduction of the CUDA programming model in 2006, we opened the parallel processing capabilities of our GPU to a broad range of compute-intensive applications, paving the way for the emergence of modern AI. In 2012, the AlexNet neural network, trained on NVIDIA GPUs, won the ImageNet computer image recognition competition, marking the “Big Bang” moment of AI. We introduced our first Tensor Core GPU in 2017, built from the ground-up for the new era of AI, and our first autonomous driving system-on-chips, or SoC, in 2018. Our acquisition of Mellanox in 2020 expanded our innovation canvas to include networking, enabled our platforms to be data center scale, and led to the introduction of a new processor class – the data processing unit, or DPU. Over the past 5 years, we have built full software stacks that run on top of our GPUs and CUDA to bring AI to the world’s largest industries, including NVIDIA DRIVE stack for autonomous driving, Clara for healthcare, and Omniverse for industrial digitalization; and introduced the NVIDIA AI Enterprise software – essentially an operating system for enterprise AI applications. In 2023, we introduced our first data center CPU, Grace, built for giant-scale AI and high performance computing, or HPC. With a strong engineering culture, we drive fast, yet harmonized, product and technology innovations in all dimensions of computing including silicon, systems, networking, software and algorithms. More than half of our engineers work on software.

pdf-block-001433-40824ffe.support: Revenue Recognition We derive our revenue from product sales, including hardware and systems, license and development arrangements, software licensing, and cloud services. We determine revenue recognition through the following steps: (1) identification of the contract with a customer; (2) identification of the performance obligations in the contract; (3) determination of the transaction price; (4) allocation of the transaction price to the performance obligations in the contract (where revenue is allocated on a relative standalone selling price basis by maximizing the use of observable inputs to determine the standalone selling price for each performance obligation); and (5) recognition of revenue when, or as, we satisfy a performance obligation. Payment from customers, per our standard payment terms, is generally due shortly after delivery of products, availability of software licenses or commencement of services.

pdf-block-000849-ce71c5ff.support: Innovation is at our core. We have invested over $58.2 billion in research and development since our inception, yielding inventions that are essential to modern computing. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market and redefined computer graphics. With our introduction of the CUDA programming model in 2006, we opened the parallel processing capabilities of our GPU to a broad range of compute-intensive applications, paving the way for the emergence of modern AI. In 2012, the AlexNet neural network, trained on NVIDIA GPUs, won the ImageNet computer image recognition competition, marking the “Big Bang” moment of AI. We introduced our first Tensor Core GPU in 2017, built from the ground-up for the new era of AI, and our first autonomous driving system-on-chips, or SoC, in 2018. Our acquisition of Mellanox in 2020 expanded our innovation canvas to include networking, enabled our platforms to be data center scale, and led to the introduction of a new processor class – the data processing unit, or DPU. Over the past 5 years, we have built full software stacks that run on top of our GPUs and CUDA to bring AI to the world’s largest industries, including NVIDIA DRIVE stack for autonomous driving, Clara for healthcare, and Omniverse for industrial digitalization; and introduced the NVIDIA AI Enterprise software – essentially an operating system for enterprise AI applications. In 2023, we introduced our first data center CPU, Grace, built for giant-scale AI and high performance computing, or HPC. With a strong engineering culture, we drive fast, yet harmonized, product and technology innovations in all dimensions of computing including silicon, systems, networking, software and algorithms. More than half of our engineers work on software.

pdf-block-001440-6cf2f47b.support: Software Licensing Our software licenses provide our customers with a right to use the software when it is made available to the customer. Customers may purchase either perpetual licenses or subscriptions to licenses, which differ mainly in the duration over which the customer benefits from the software. Software licenses are frequently sold along with support, which includes the right to receive, on a when-and-if available basis, future unspecified software updates and upgrades. Revenue from software licenses is recognized up front when the software is made available to the customer. Software support revenue is recognized ratably over the service period, or as services are performed.
